title: Membership attestation, org-membership/1 (DEC-0127)
description: What an organization server states about one person's membership of one organization, for one reader, for at most 24 hours: the organization, the reader (audience), a subject pairwise to that pair, a role, whether the membership is active or ended, and its revision. A key the organization's org-key-set/1 lists signs it over the RFC 8785 form of the document without sig (the register's org-membership/1, DEC-0063). Any organization server issues it (MD-9 path (a)). It names no person: no name, address or email.

issuer.description: The organization server's https:// origin in lower case, as the organization's key set and the estate's pin name it.

audience.description: The reader this attestation is for, as the issuer registered it (a person's Fabric, a product's client). A verifier refuses one for another audience.

subject.description: The member, pairwise: one opaque id per (org, audience, person), so two readers cannot join their records by it. Never an email, a name, the estate id or a device id.

role.description: The role in the organization. An issuer maps its own roles onto these three; a finer one travels in extensions and grants nothing by itself.

external.description: True for a guest of the organization: a person whose own estate is not the organization's (a contractor, a partner's person).

status.description: ended: the membership is over; the issuer states it with a higher revision rather than going silent, so the reader ends it at once (OM-5).

revision.description: Rises with every attestation the issuer states for this (org, audience, subject); a verifier refuses a lower one and the same one with other bytes.

membershipEndsAt.description: When the membership itself ends (a fixed term, a guest's end), or null. Past it the verifier reads the attestation as ended.

expiresAt.description: After notBefore and at most 24 hours after issuedAt (FAC-SEM-145).

extensions.description: The issuer's own statements, each named by a domain it controls, a slash and a name; {} when none. A reader ignores one it does not know, and none grants authority (OM-1).

alg.description: Ed25519 only; ES256 may join additively by a later decision.

kid.description: The signing key's kid, as the organization's current org-key-set/1 lists it.

sig.description: The Ed25519 signature (64 bytes, base64url without padding) over the UTF-8 RFC 8785 form of the document without sig.

org.description: An organization's context id, org:<orgId> (DEC-0082), compared as written.
